prompts.title: Timeless Wedding Couple Studio Photography
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic studio portrait of a romantic couple in elegant wedding attire, captured with a timeless, luxurious aesthetic and refined emotional intimacy.
Maintain accurate identity and precise face matching to the provided reference image for both subjects — preserve exact facial structure, proportions, skin texture, hairlines, and overall likeness. Do not alter any facial features.
Composition & Framing:
Medium-full portrait (mid-thigh to slightly above head), centered composition with balanced negative space on both sides. The couple stands close together in a soft profile orientation, bodies slightly angled toward each other. Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Pose & Interaction:
The couple stands in an intimate pose, facing each other closely.
The man gently holds the woman at her waist with both hand.
The woman’s body is slightly turned, showcasing the back detail of her dress while her face turns toward the man. One arm rests gently around his shoulder, while she holds a bouquet in the other hand. Her head is tilted slightly upward as she looks at him.
Both subjects maintain a natural, relaxed posture.
Expression:
Soft, romantic expressions with subtle smiles.
Eyes focused on each other, conveying warmth, love, and emotional connection.
Outfit & Styling:
Man: Tailored black tuxedo with silk lapels, crisp white dress shirt, and a neatly tied black bow tie. Clean, polished formal styling.
Woman: Elegant high-neck, long-sleeve bridal gown crafted from intricate floral lace. The dress features a dramatic open-back design.
Hair styled in a sleek low bun, adorned with a delicate silver tiara.
Props:
A hand-tied bouquet of fresh ivory tulips with natural green stems, held by the woman.
Background:
Dark charcoal-grey smooth studio backdrop with a subtle vignette. Seamless and minimal, enhancing subject focus with no distractions.
Lighting Setup:
Soft, diffused studio key light from front/side creating smooth skin tones and gentle highlights.
Subtle fill light to maintain detail in shadows.
Controlled shadow falloff for a cinematic, moody depth.
Lace textures and fabric details are softly illuminated without harsh contrast.
Camera & Technical Details:
Eye-level camera angle
85mm lens look
Shallow depth of field
Sharp focus on faces and fine textures
Ultra-high resolution, 8K quality
Photorealistic rendering with natural skin texture (no plastic or over-smoothing)
Style:
Luxury wedding editorial, cinematic, timeless, high-end fashion portrait, ultra-clean and refined.
